segments.text: Your bewailed infirmities do not break the bond of the everlasting Covenant. The bond of the Covenant holds firm, notwithstanding your defects and weaknesses, Jer. 32. 40. Iniquities prevail against me, saith David, yet in the same breath he adds, as for our transgressions thou shalt purge them away, Psal. 65. 3. He's still thy God, thy Father for all this.
